notes.title: INDIKA Photo Mode Available Now!
notes.content:
🖤 INDIKA Photo Mode - Capture the Madness and Win! 💛 

Greetings, INDIKA enthusiasts and aspiring surrealist photographers!

We're thrilled to announce that INDIKA is getting even more bizarre and captivating with our brand new Photo Mode! Now you can capture all those wonderfully weird moments in stunning detail – and potentially win some exclusive prizes!

[previewyoutube=POGKOVVLz9s;full][/previewyoutube]

📸 What's in store for you?

 Freeze time and space to set up the perfect shot
 Adjust camera angles to showcase INDIKA's surreal landscapes
 Play with filters to enhance the game's already mind-bending visuals
 Add stickers and frames to truly make your screenshots pop (or terrify)
 Share your creations directly to social media and make your friends question your sanity


Whether you're posing with peculiar characters, documenting unexplainable phenomena, or just admiring the twisted beauty of INDIKA's world, Photo Mode is your ticket to preserving those "Did that really just happen?" moments.

🎮 How to access Photo Mode
Simply press {INSERT_KEYBIND_HERE} during gameplay to enter Photo Mode. It's that easy! Just remember, the game world stops when you're in Photo Mode, but your mind might keep racing.

"We wanted to give players a way to capture the essence of INDIKA's uniqueness. With Photo Mode, you're not just playing the game – you're curating your own gallery of the absurd." - 11 bit studios team

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38315141/839f709f54c5e0a7024e11fdb99e9945d1698bd6.jpg

📣 INDIKA Photo Contest - Show Us Your Best Shots!
To celebrate the launch of Photo Mode, we're excited to announce the INDIKA Photo Contest!

🏆 How to Participate:

 Take your most creative, bizarre, or beautiful screenshots using INDIKA's new Photo Mode
 Share your masterpiece on Twitter/X, Facebook, or Instagram
 Tag your post with #INDIKAPhotoMode


📅 Contest Duration:
October 21, 2024 - October 28, 2024 (23:59 CET)

🎁 Prizes:
Three lucky winners will receive an exclusive INDIKA-themed t-shirt!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38315141/e6faa147aef134276afd5101092ac6a44125e717.jpg

Our panel of judges will select the most creative and unique entries. Winners will be announced within one week after the contest ends.

📜 Important Notes:

 You must be 18 or older to participate
 By entering, you grant us the right to use your screenshot for marketing purposes

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38315141/36044f584224050a9f9c2645fc1dc617ff9aded2.jpg

 Full contest rules can be found here.

So, what are you waiting for? Dive back into INDIKA, snap some shots, and show the world just how gloriously strange your journey has been!

Stay weird, stay wonderful, and happy photographing!

Your ever-enigmatic friends at 11 bit studios

P.S.
Remember, what happens in INDIKA... gets immortalized in Photo Mode. Use this power wisely (or don't, we're not here to judge). Good luck in the contest!

notes.title: INDIKA Original Soundtrack
notes.content:
🖤 INDIKA's Haunting Soundtrack Now Available! 💛 

Greetings, lost souls and wayward nuns!

The INDIKA Original Soundtrack has escaped its divine (or perhaps, devilish?) confinement and is now available everywhere! Composed by Mike Sabadash, this auditory journey will take you back to our alternate Russia at the turn of the XIX century, where the line between holy and unholy blurs like a feverish dream.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38315141/1961eabb32aba9c4d9e5888fa3d35595ac470f3a.jpg

What (un)holy melodies await?


 24 tracks of mind-bending, soul-stirring music
 A perfect blend of eerie atmospherics and classic 8-bit chiptune elements
 Each track named after a book of the Bible’s Old Testament (because why not mix the sacred with the profane?)
 From "Genesis" to "Apocalypse," with some surprising stops in between


Whether you're questioning your faith, chatting with the devil, or just enjoying a leisurely stroll through surreal landscapes, this soundtrack is your perfect companion.

Where to find this auditory temptation?

The INDIKA OST is available on all major music platforms. Go forth and listen, but remember – headphones are recommended. We can't be held responsible for any existential crises that may occur in public spaces.

"We wanted to create a soundtrack that makes you question your sanity, just like our dear Indika. Mission accomplished?" - Mike Sabadash, probably…

A match made in... somewhere
This heavenly (or hellish) collaboration between 11 bit studios and Milan Records marks our second foray into the world of surreal soundscapes. First - the Frostpunk 2, now INDIKA – we're on a roll!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38315141/d8055ae8498faca5ed5b09c4a23fdbf5e659fe81.jpg

So, what are you waiting for? Dive into the INDIKA OST and let your ears experience the same delightful confusion as your eyes did in the game!

Stay odd, stay questioning, and happy listening!

Your ever-enigmatic friends at 11 bit studios

P.S. 
If you start hearing voices after listening to the soundtrack, don't worry. That's probably just Mike Sabadash whispering the secrets of the universe directly into your brain. Totally normal.

notes.title: Best Indie Game at Golden Joystick Awards Nomination
notes.content:
Adventurers who embraced INDIKA's monastic life!

We have some thrilling news to share with you all today.

Best Indie Game Nomination: INDIKA

We're immensely proud and humbled to announce that 🖤 INDIKA has been nominated for "Best Indie Game" in the 42nd Golden Joystick Awards! 🖤 This nomination is a celebration of your willingness to engage with its challenging themes and unique gameplay mechanics. Your journey through faith and doubt has allowed us to push the boundaries of storytelling in games.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38315141/6220dce8a871f1f088ae62304a43752a8ff70b38.jpg

This recognition affirms the power of indie games to create meaningful, thought-provoking experiences. It's a testament to the connection we've built with you - our players, who have embraced INDIKA's distinctive narrative and gameplay.

11 bit studios: Studio of the Year Nomination

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38315141/0e7d58e760fccf69972552781e162138f06c76af.jpg


The exciting news extends beyond INDIKA! 11 bit studios has been nominated for "Studio of the Year". This nomination reflects our commitment to creating diverse, engaging experiences across all our titles, fueled by your support and feedback.

More Heartwarming News

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38315141/88e121022a1caf7d6adb996ee1a95631fd921040.jpg

We're also very happy to share that our post-apocalyptic, snow-covered city-builder: Frostpunk 2, has been nominated for "PC Game of the Year" further showcasing the range of experiences we strive to create.

Your Voice Matters!
These nominations are a direct result of your support and engagement. Now, we invite you to make your voice heard once again. If INDIKA has moved you, challenged you, or sparked meaningful reflections, we'd be honored to have your vote.

Cast your vote here: http://goldenjoysticks.com

Every vote is a reminder of the impact that indie games can have. Thank you for being part of INDIKA's journey and for helping to showcase the power of innovative storytelling in games. 🖤

With deepest gratitude,
11 bit studios Team

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41041469/d66890585e69dc85e767c441030ff071df76dab8.jpg

notes.title: First INDIKA hotfix out now
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We are truly overwhelmed by the incredible support from our community following the release of INDIKA. Your enthusiasm and encouragement truly mean the world to us. Thank you for making this journey (to hell and back) with us.

The first hotfix for INDIKA is out now, improving the game's overall performance:
 Shader Pre-Compilation has been implemented to enhance performance and improve overall stability
 Improved performance on Steam Deck
 DLSS fixed on the Monastery level
 Minor fixes and improvements

Stay tuned as more great updates are coming soon!

For a limited time you can grab INDIKA with a 10% launch discount:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1373960/INDIKA/

Take care,
Odd Meter and 11 bit studios
